The site is Pine Crossing. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

Her own 9 June message in #central-team says the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and the staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login.

I couldn't find any later update saying it was fixed, either in that channel or in the shared files. I also didn't find an address or site ID for Pine Crossing, so I told her to check that against the Marrow Agrisupply records.
